complaint_text: I received an urgent email claiming to be from my bank asking me to confirm my password on a suspicious portal.
An SMS arrived stating that my Netflix account was suspended and directed me to a fake billing link to re-enter payment info.
An unauthorized wire transaction of $2,400 was debited from my checking account via a compromised merchant gateway.
A fraudulent caller claiming to be credit card support tricked me into approving an OTP and stole funds from my savings.
Someone opened three fraudulent credit card lines under my Social Security number without my authorization.
An unknown impostor forged my national identity documents to take out an auto loan in another state.
My primary Gmail account was compromised, my recovery phone number was changed, and I am completely locked out.
An attacker bypassed my two-factor authentication and hijacked my Steam gaming profile and inventory.
A group of anonymous accounts has been sending me relentless death threats and abusive messages across my Instagram posts.
I am being stalked online by an ex-colleague who posts defamatory lies and derogatory slurs about me on public forums.
A fake profile using my full legal name and stolen family pictures is impersonating me and soliciting money from my friends.
Someone cloned my Twitter handle and is posting deceptive cryptocurrency giveaways while pretending to be me.
A downloaded zip file encrypted all documents on my PC and displayed a ransom note demanding Bitcoin payment.
My office workstation was infected with a keylogger that covertly transmitted my credentials to a command server.
I ordered a designer watch from an online store, paid via credit card, but the site disappeared and nothing was ever delivered.
A fraudulent marketplace seller sent me an empty cardboard box instead of the laptop I purchased and refused all contact.
